description: Comments on a channel (20 per hour at most per owner). Without `author`, the server makes a nickname that stays the same for the same owner, so the person does not get a different name for each message.

author.description: Nickname to use; without it, the server makes a stable one.

body.description: The comment text. The limit is in `max_length` of the list.

id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

name: post_comment
title: Post a comment
